core: Lamellipodial actin protrusion in cell motility
name: Arp2/3-driven lamellipodial protrusion at the leading edge
rationale: All members concern leading-edge actin protrusion (lamellipodia, pseudopodia, ruffles, spreading) during migration; unlike confusables centred on actin severing, CDC42/IQGAP or focal adhesion turnover, this theme carries Arp2/3 nucleation and WASP/WAVE activation.

name: Methionine and selenocompound metabolism
rationale: Members centre on methionine/SAM metabolism and salvage; the selenium compound metabolism members (SeMet, MeSeH, H2Se) are what no confusable has, while confusables add folate, choline/carnitine or MTR/MTRR defects.

name: Homology-directed double-strand break repair after end resection
rationale: Members cover DSB end resection and the resection-dependent repair routes (HR including BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects, D-loop resolution, SSA, MMEJ), whereas confusables hold DSB sensing, ATM signalling, PARylation and classical NHEJ.

name: Non-vesicular phospholipid transfer at ER membrane contacts
rationale: Members describe ER tethering/localization and intermembrane transfer of phospholipids such as PI and PC; confusables instead concern sphingolipid metabolism, ER tubule shaping, flippases or glycolipid transport.

qualifier: clathrin sorting to lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles
name: Trans-Golgi clathrin sorting to lysosomes and related organelles
rationale: Members cover TGN clathrin vesicle formation and cargo loading for lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles (melanosomes, platelet dense granules); confusables are COPI/intra-Golgi or endosome-to-Golgi retrograde trafficking.

name: IL-15 and IL-21 signaling in NK cell development
rationale: All members are IL-15/IL-21 signaling or NK cell differentiation and proliferation, distinguishing it from confusables built on IL-2/IL-7/IL-9 T cell signaling or IL-10/IL-12/IL-23.

name: Classical and lectin pathway complement activation
rationale: Members describe complement activation to C3/C5 and opsonization, with the lectin/ficolin pathway setting it apart from confusables focused on the alternative pathway and complement regulation.

name: Myeloid proinflammatory chemokine and cytokine production
rationale: Members concern inflammatory cytokine/chemokine output by myeloid and dendritic cells and its regulation (IL-8, MCP-1, chronic inflammation), whereas confusables emphasise monocyte recruitment and adhesion or NF-kB-driven lymphocyte activation.

qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR2 via FRS, SHC and PLC
name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 signaling via FRS and SHC adaptors
rationale: All members are FRS-, SHC- or PLC-mediated cascades from FGFR1/FGFR2, unlike confusables covering PI3K cascades, FGFR4/betaKlotho, ligand binding or oncogenic mutants.

name: Presynaptic calcium control of glutamate and GABA release
rationale: Members cover presynaptic Ca2+ and vesicle exocytosis regulation of glutamate and GABA secretion and short-term plasticity; confusables hold the generic release cycle/SNARE priming or GPCR-mediated presynaptic inhibition.

name: Locomotor and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Most members are motor behaviors (walking, swimming, righting, grooming, proprioception) with glycinergic and cerebellar contributors, distinguishing it from confusables built on vocalization, social learning and auditory responses.

qualifier: by dendritic, myeloid and B-lineage cells
name: MHC class II antigen presentation by professional APCs
rationale: Members are MHC II peptide processing/presentation and surface signatures of dendritic cells, monocytes and plasma/germinal center B cells; confusables are B cell identity, T cell costimulation or CD1 lipid antigen presentation.

name: BMP-SMAD signaling in mesoderm and heart morphogenesis
rationale: Members combine BMP/SMAD signaling regulation with mesoderm specification and heart/pericardial/coronary morphogenesis; confusables concern endothelial differentiation, ventricular trabeculation or second heart field without BMP signaling.

name: Fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose synthesis/catabolism and its disorders plus glycerol/alditol metabolism, distinguishing it from confusables on gluconeogenesis, galactose or pentose metabolism.

qualifier: with sodium and potassium transport regulation
name: Osmotic stress response and sodium-potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members describe hyper/hypotonic and salt stress responses, water homeostasis and regulation of Na+/K+ transport; confusables emphasise aldosterone, sodium import inhibition or vasopressin-aquaporin water handling.

name: Lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene, lipoxin, hepoxilin, HETE and EET synthesis and fatty acid omega-hydroxylation; confusables hold leukotriene/prostanoid receptor signaling or omega-3 resolvin and protectin synthesis.

name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide defense against microbes
rationale: Members describe antimicrobial peptide production, defensins, metal sequestration and killing of bacteria, fungi and other microbes at mucosae; confusables concern bacterial entry, intestinal epithelium or neutrophil degranulation.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and AKT-regulated FOXO transcription
rationale: Members combine the HSF1 heat shock response and protein refolding with AKT/acetylation control of FOXO transcription; confusables are NFE2L2, ER UPR or p53/mTORC1 programs without HSF1.

name: Cytoplasmic translation initiation and ribosomal subunit joining
rationale: Members cover eIF2/eIF3, 43S formation, scanning, start codon recognition and 60S joining, unlike confusables on translation termination, mRNA surveillance or Pol I/III transcription.

name: MET receptor signaling to PI3K, SHP2 and RAP1/RAC1
rationale: All three members are MET activating PI3K/AKT, PTPN11 and RAP1/RAC1, distinguishing it from MET-PTK2/integrin adhesion signaling and EGFR/ERBB2 or FGFR cascades.

name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension
rationale: Members describe PCP protein localization and Wnt/PCP signaling driving convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate; confusables concern axial mesoderm and neural plate patterning.

name: Cobalamin absorption, transport and intracellular processing
rationale: Members span dietary cobalamin uptake, plasma transport, cellular uptake and processing and their inherited defects; confusables are other B vitamins or downstream methylmalonyl/propionyl-CoA defects.

core: Tight junction paracellular and magnesium transport
name: Tight junction paracellular and magnesium ion transport
rationale: The clearest shared thread is claudin-type tight junction paracellular transport and magnesium/inositol transport by multi-pass membrane proteins, with generic oligomerization members; confusables are aquaporin, chloride-cotransporter or metabolic groupings.

core: Nucleic acid sensing driving type I interferon
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING sensing driving type I interferon
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing, their regulation and HSE deficiencies, and dendritic-cell interferon production; confusables centre on RIG-I/IFN-stimulated responses and TBK1 regulation.

name: Histidine and histamine metabolism with proton-coupled peptide transport
rationale: Members combine histidine/histamine metabolism and signaling with SLC15-type proton/oligopeptide and histidine transport; confusables are generic amino acid transporter sets lacking histamine.
